purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Depot Activity Revert Empty Return details.
features: Revert Empty Return Function allows the user to change the status of Port Release from Empty Return to previous status.
Container linked to a B/L is not allowed; the user should delink the container from the B/L first.

events.description: Reverts the PR status from Empty Return to its previous status. Message: "Empty Return container status reverted successfully"
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Menu icon near the desired PR Number and clicks Revert Empty Return from the single function menu
